title: John Lear possibly fed disinformation to Lazar

tellings.quote: Bob Lazar would hang around some interesting characters. Guys like John Lear, who flew cargo planes for the CIA in the seventies.
His story was leaked to the public by a CIA pilot, a close friend of his named John Lear who flew cargo planes for the CIA and set all sorts of aviation records in the '70s.
tellings.difference: Says Lear leaked Lazar's story to the public, and adds his aviation records and the involvement of Knapp and Corbell.
tellings.link_reason: Both present John Lear, the CIA cargo pilot, as the man behind the Lazar story, possibly as a CIA operation.

as_told.title: John Lear leaks Lazar story as CIA operation

tellings.quote: he had been spending a decade outside of Area 51 and you spend a decade outside of Area 51 the security guards know you there
tellings.difference: Adds that Lear spent a decade outside Area 51, where the guards knew him, and says outright that the CIA pushed out the Lazar story; also credits Corbell and Knapp.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the host's theory that John Lear was a route by which the intelligence community fed the Lazar story out.

as_told.title: John Lear outside Area 51 and the CIA pushing out the Lazar story

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that Bob Lazar, a man who has told a famous story about secret alien technology, spent time with some unusual people. One was John Lear, who according to Michels flew cargo planes for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, in the 1970s. The idea behind the story is that Lear may have fed Lazar disinformation, meaning false information planted on purpose, which if true would mean Lazar's story was shaped by someone else.
